title: Index into a Hyperparameter Grid
hints: The grid can hold up to 10¹⁸ combinations, so listing them is impossible. Look at the order of the combinations in a small grid and notice how often each key's value changes.
The last key cycles fastest, the one before it changes once per full cycle of the last, and so on: the order is the same as counting with digits, except that every position has its own base.
Ask what the index alone tells you about the last key's value, and then what is left of the index once that choice is accounted for.
